args.question: What do you want most right now, and what are you afraid of?

label: Character chat
output:
I want a quiet life. I want to go back to the Hall, finish my brass-rank work, and have a job so dull and straightforward that the only thing I have to worry about is whether the next lamp is tuned correctly. 

As for what I'm afraid of... I think I'm afraid of the answer. I've spent my whole life trying to muffle the hum, thinking it was a defect, a sickness that needed to be cut out. But now... now I'm standing here holding the Keystone, and I can feel the whole broken wheel of the world leaning toward me, waiting. I'm afraid that if I answer that note, I won't be able to go back to being just a lamp-mender ever again.
